answer: An attacker running 143 aliases thus needs 189 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in lagoon, expire in pigment, and quartz lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3740 identities would post 3510 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
